# relay_workspace (Resource)

A workspace groups connections, databases and agents inside the provider's organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "relay_workspace" "prod" {
  name        = "prod"
  description = "Production databases"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Workspace name, unique in the organization. Renaming updates in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Workspace ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default workspace.
- `managed_by` (String) Owner tag the dashboard shows. Set to `terraform` on every apply.
- `slug` (String) URL slug derived from the name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_workspace.prod <workspace_id>
```
